PROGRAMME OVERVIEW
A source-backed Sociology programme preview for local browser acceptance.
What you will study
Below is a list of things you will learn in this programme, grouped by common themes.
•
Communication and academic writing
How this theme fits your programme
You will practise communicating clearly in speech and writing, understanding written information, and presenting ideas. These abilities support your Sociology studies; they complement, rather than replace, the programme's research and reporting work.
What you will be able to do
•
Nigerian peoples and culture
How this theme fits your programme
You will study Nigerian peoples and cultures through historical and social examples. This theme adds Nigerian context to your university learning; it is not a complete account of every community or a substitute for the programme's African and Nigerian societies theme.
What you will be able to do
▤
Philosophy and reasoning
How this theme fits your programme
You will examine philosophical questions and practise logic—checking whether reasons support a conclusion. This builds general reasoning, while the programme's Sociology themes apply ideas and evidence to social life.
What you will be able to do

Peace, conflict and security
How this theme fits your programme
You will learn key ways people describe peace, conflict and security, and consider how conflict can arise and be addressed. This introduces broad concepts; the Sociology themes examine particular institutions, inequalities and settings in greater depth.
